claim_text: High-dose vitamin E supplementation is not a generic antioxidant or anti-aging strategy and may increase bleeding risk, particularly with anticoagulant or antiplatelet medicines.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, indication-specific recommendations and avoid unsupported supplementation.

population.other_context: People considering vitamin E for general antioxidant interest.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Relevant dietary and supplemental forms; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Vitamin E fact sheet describes evidence limitations and bleeding risk.
limitations: Do not extrapolate high-dose supplement risks to normal food intake; no dose from this claim.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
